sourceAudit.sourceOverlapCaution: Historical pool source-node unions only; recheck exact current source per native position before locks or contract.

numbering.freezeRule: P001..P117 stable research-packet IDs; no renumber after dispatch; pool must be split by mathematical invariant before strict-family coding.
numbering.sizingRule: Alternate historical remaining-count descending into opposite ends; within each lane move small medium-risk pilots to endpoints; counts are NOT actual workload or potential A.
numbering.activeClaimRule: One active family sub-contract per lane by default; reserve source, files, full task fingerprints and working branch in Issue before any write.
numbering.crossing: If one lane reaches an already claimed packet or conflicts on exact source/write paths, mark BLOCKED and take the next unclaimed packet in its direction; do not renumber.

safety.sourceLock: No simultaneous changes to same original source node/task; historical cross-lane source collision list is advisory only.
safety.acceptance: Source-locked original, authentic events, mathematical invariant/negative tests, latest Check, unchanged grader and State-v2, PR exact-head Chromium/P10/offline/artifacts then independent main Required/Fallback; no fake A from final answer.
safety.integration: Only central integrator modifies shared registries, release/hash files, merge order and main acceptance; per-lane PRs remain Draft until integrated.
safety.actions: GitHub identity alone does not create independent Actions quotas on one repository; fork Actions need explicit account/repository setup and cannot bypass central gates.
safety.nonGoals: No CI weakening, no VPS deployment, no forced conversion of all 1183 non-A tasks, no manual multiwave in planning phase.

packets.notes: A pilot: preaudit only, separate actual area-invariant sources and control actions
B pilot: preaudit only, signed and fractional jumps may require distinct contracts
